assertion.statement: Istio CRDs in the istio-base Helm chart are now templated by default so they can be upgraded with `helm upgrade istio-base` instead of `kubectl apply`, and CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: The text describes a changed recommended workflow that is optional (kubectl apply can still be used), not a mandatory operator step, so no fitting change type is clear.; applicability: Exposure depends on how the environment previously installed or upgraded CRDs (Helm vs kubectl), which the text does not tie to a checkable condition.; consequence: The evidence says only that the workflow is allowed and that CRD labels change; it does not state that anything fails if the operator does nothing.
